words.gloss: those who do not agree in heart
is of a nature to be trusted

literal: Those who do not fit in their mind, even in the slightest measure, by their words, to trust is not the right way.
translation: It is never right to trust those whose minds do not agree with you, no matter how much they promise with their words.
modern: மனதால் நம்மோடு பொருந்தாதவர்களை, அவர்கள் கூறும் சொற்களைக் கொண்டு எவ்வகையிலும் நம்புவது தகுதியற்றது.
explanation: This couplet warns us against trusting insincere people whose inner minds do not align with their outward behavior. The phrase 'மனத்தின் அமையாதவர்' refers to those whose hearts are not truly united or in harmony with us. Even if they speak sweet, reassuring words, one should not rely on them in the slightest degree. True friendship requires a union of minds, and relying merely on verbal assurances from those who are mentally detached is a path to deception.
